reply: Semester fees vary by degree program and semester. Please confirm the applicable fee with the relevant university office.
Admission requirements, eligibility, and merit criteria depend on the program. Check the latest admission information with the relevant university department.
Class and office timings may vary by department and day. Please confirm the current schedule with your department.
For library cards, book availability, borrowing rules, and opening hours, please contact the university library.
Hostel accommodation, fees, and room availability depend on university policies and available spaces. Please contact the relevant hostel office.
